stories.title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI systems, is making money much faster than before — they're now earning $65 billion per year. They added $18 billion in earnings in just two months.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: AI at work puts new pressure on managers
stories.simple_summary: AI tools at work are changing what managers have to do. They need to figure out how to use AI and what rules to follow.
stories.why_it_matters: If you manage employees, you may need to think about how AI could help or change the work your team does.

stories.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
stories.simple_summary: A startup called Relay that helped automate tasks is shutting down. Its staff is joining Google to build AI features into the Chrome web browser.
stories.why_it_matters: Google is working on making AI tools easier to use in Chrome, which may bring AI features to everyday web browsing.

stories.title: AI Slop Is Everywhere. Spotify, LinkedIn and Others Have Had Enough.
stories.simple_summary: Companies like Spotify and LinkedIn are getting tired of low-quality AI-generated content (called 'AI slop') cluttering their platforms.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use these apps or advertise on them, there may be less spam and junk content soon.

stories.title: Billionaire Ray Dalio Says Today's Artificial Intelligence (AI) Market Echoes 1929 and 2000. History Says Investors Should Watch Valuations Closely.
stories.simple_summary: A billionaire investor is warning that AI company valuations look dangerously expensive, similar to bubble periods before big market crashes in 1929 and 2000.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Wispr Flow valued at $2 billion on investor demand for AI voice-to-text startups
stories.simple_summary: A company called Wispr Flow, which turns voice into written text, was just valued at $2 billion because many investors want to fund this type of AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is destroying old, rare books to use them for training AI — because rare books have information that regular online sources don't have.
stories.why_it_matters: This is worth knowing if you care about preserving old books, but it doesn't directly affect your daily life.

stories.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
stories.simple_summary: A company called Groq raised $350 million. It used to make AI computer chips but is now shifting to running cloud computing services (computers available over the internet).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia (a big computer chip company) is investing $1.5 billion to make sure their chips are used in a data center built by SoftBank for OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia is helping secure $105 billion in financing for a massive new data center that OpenAI is building in Ohio.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation as it looks beyond dictation
stories.simple_summary: Wispr, a company that transcribes speech to text, raised $280 million and is expanding into new areas like recording and organizing meeting notes.
stories.why_it_matters: If you take a lot of meeting notes or record conversations for work, better voice-to-text tools may become available.

stories.title: AI eyes in the sky: new satellites and artificial intelligence are transforming wildfire detection
stories.simple_summary: New satellites and AI are being used together to spot wildfires earlier and faster than before.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in an area with wildfire risk, this could mean faster warnings and better protection.
